title: Loki Log Pipeline with MinIO
summary: Agents ship labelled log streams to Loki's distributor and ingesters, which flush chunks and index to MinIO; queriers serve LogQL to Grafana.

nodes.label: Alloy / Promtail
nodes.detail: Tails container and file logs, attaches labels like namespace and app, and pushes streams to Loki.

nodes.label: Distributor
nodes.detail: Receives pushes, validates labels and limits, and uses consistent hashing to pick ingesters, replicating for durability.

nodes.label: Ingester
nodes.detail: Builds compressed chunks per stream in memory, backed by a write-ahead log, and flushes them when full or old.

nodes.label: MinIO Chunks
nodes.detail: S3-compatible object store holding compressed log chunks. Cheap and durable compared with indexing full text.

nodes.label: Index
nodes.detail: Index of label sets to chunk references, stored with chunks in object storage and cached locally.

nodes.label: Querier
nodes.detail: Fetches data from ingesters for recent logs and from object storage for older logs, then filters lines.

nodes.label: Query Frontend
nodes.detail: Splits large time ranges into smaller queries, caches results and queues work for queriers.

nodes.label: Grafana
nodes.detail: Sends LogQL such as label selectors and line filters, and shows log lines or metrics derived from logs.

steps.title: Agent ships logs
steps.text: Alloy or Promtail tails logs, adds labels and pushes streams over HTTP.

steps.title: Distributor routes
steps.text: The distributor validates streams and hashes them to ingesters, replicating writes.

steps.title: Ingester builds chunks
steps.text: Logs accumulate in memory chunks protected by a WAL until flush conditions are met.

steps.title: Grafana asks with LogQL
steps.text: A label selector query goes to the query frontend, which splits it by time.

steps.title: Querier merges sources
steps.text: It finds chunks via the index, reads MinIO and ingesters, filters lines and returns results.
